title: gastify: scan → cooked
card: A real domain line with a side input and a feedback loop: a photographed receipt becomes pantry stock, cookable recipes, a cooking event, and a proficiency score that changes what gets offered next. Numbers are illustrative.
lede: Eight machines take a photographed receipt to a cooking event and back into a proficiency score. The shape is gastify's; the numbers are invented for this example — the real page, with measured numbers, belongs in gastify's own command center once the suite propagates there.
handle: Machine 6 is the reason this line is worth drawing: it consumes two things — the pantry that came down the belt, and a recipe catalogue that never did. A side input is the honest name for that, and machine 8 feeding back into machine 6 is why this is a loop, not a funnel. Both are exactly what a linear diagram of the same eight boxes silently drops.
source: structure from the gastify domain; NUMBERS ARE ILLUSTRATIVE — invented for this example by operator ruling (2026-08-01), never measured. This page teaches the suite's grammar; it is not a status page for gastify and does not update when gastify changes.
